66.subtopic: Colloids, Classification, Coagulation and Hardy-Schulze Rule
66.solution: Soap lather is a gas (air) dispersed in a liquid (soap solution). A gas dispersed in a liquid is a foam. Option C.

67.subtopic: Carboxylic Acids, Properties, Reactions and Derivatives
67.solution: Carboxylic acids form two hydrogen bonds per pair of molecules (dimers), stronger than the single hydrogen bonds of alcohols and amines; a tertiary amine forms none. So propanoic acid, \(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{COOH}\), boils highest. Option D.
